案件取自你提供、并与官方文件核对一致的 BOCSAR suburb CSV。官方: Incident counts come from the BOCSAR suburb CSV, checked against the official download. The overview page lists coverage through 2025, while the downloaded file contains monthly data through June 2026. The study area uses the ABS 2021 Greater Sydney boundary and includes suburbs with any area inside it. Counts and rates for cross-boundary suburbs cover the entire suburb.
暴力犯罪按 BOCSAR 季报口径汇总。袭击合计包含家暴及非家暴袭击，袭警另计入: Violent crime follows the BOCSAR quarterly report definition. Total assault includes domestic violence-related and non-domestic violence-related assault. Assaults on police are counted separately under violent crime. The assault data combine common assault and assaults causing injury, so injury counts and severity cannot be separated. Residential break-ins use the Break and enter dwelling category.
人口为零或未匹配警方数据时，相关字段显示「—」。有正人口的 suburb 均参与: A dash marks unavailable values, including rates where Census population is zero or police records could not be matched. Suburbs with a positive population and available counts are ranked. Rates fluctuate more in small populations, and the denominator excludes visitors to business and tourist areas. Rankings use unrounded rates and allow ties.
正案件率按第 20、40、60、80、95 百分位分成六档，最深色标出最高约 5: Positive rates are grouped into six bands at the 20th, 40th, 60th, 80th and 95th percentiles. The darkest shade marks roughly the highest 5%.
